facts.text: As a women's college, Mount Saint Mary's University does not consider men for traditional undergraduate degree programs.

sources.title: Transfer Events - Admission & Aid - MSMU
sources.quote: As a women's college, MSMU does not consider men for our traditional undergraduate degree programs.

facts.text: Mount Saint Mary's University operates two distinct campuses in Los Angeles: Chalon and Doheny.

sources.title: An Inside Look at Mount Saint Mary's Doheny and Chalon Campuses
sources.quote: At Mount Saint Mary's University Los Angeles, our two campuses — Chalon and Doheny — are the heart of all we do, and they'll be the center of your time here.
